title: ghola --output-events json line
description: ghola --output-events json writes one of these objects on each line of stderr. A start line comes before each transfer, a retry line before each retry, and a done or error line after the transfer. With --jobs, the lines of several transfers mix; the url field tells them apart.

attempt.description: retry: the number of this retry.

wait_ms.description: retry: the wait before this retry, in milliseconds. Absent when there is no wait.

exit_code.description: done and error: the exit code of the transfer (ghola explain CODE).

status.description: done and error: the last HTTP status, when there was a response.

bytes.description: done and error: the body bytes that ghola wrote.

file.description: done: the file that holds the body, when it is not stdout.

seconds.description: done and error: the time of the transfer.
